coaching.headline: Rotation kills off mid and offlane preceded four of seven allied Fangtooth and Prime takes; the enemy took one, no allied inhibitor fell.

flags.text: Lt. Belica: a game-high nine kills, four on other lanes, three before Fangtooth, Orb Prime and the Core.
Khaimera's 59092 objective damage led all ten players and beat the whole enemy team's 16217.
The allied second Fangtooth cost three deaths to Legion: Sparrow, then Khaimera at the pit, then Dekker.
Sparrow died four damn times outside any detected fight; two preceded lost allied mid and duo outers.

focus.title: Keep rotating, cut the deaths outside fights
focus.action: After the duo lane opens, the duo moves as a pair until Legion and Argus show on the map, regroups before every Fangtooth, and every rotation kill heads to the nearest objective.

17.call: Won 3-1 with Khaimera already dead, in two separate plays: Dekker killed Revenant and Legion killed Sparrow on the duo lane, while Greystone and Lt. Belica killed Crunch and Adele in the enemy half. The enemy offlane outer fell next; push the open lane after a won fight.

21.call: Won 3-0 in two separate plays: Dekker killed Argus and Revenant on the duo lane, Lt. Belica killed Adele on the offlane. The allied mid outer fell, then Orb Prime went allied. When Lt. Belica rotates off mid, ping the team to cover the mid outer.

28.9.call: Won 3-1 in the enemy half: Crunch killed Dekker first on mid, Sparrow answered on Crunch, then Sparrow and Lt. Belica finished Adele and Legion in the enemy jungle before Orb Prime went allied. When Crunch opens on the support, answer on Crunch and turn the won fight into Orb Prime.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: A hell of a farm game: 20210 gold, the most of all ten, on 11 CS per minute against a 7.9 norm. Keep that farm pace between rotations.
Razed the enemy mid inner and the Core; both deaths came to Crunch on mid in the allied half. When Crunch is unseen, ward the mid flanks before pushing.
97d538d3-a1de-457b-b9b0-327f910a80b6: Seven deaths, the allied high; four outside any detected fight, three of those on duo, two to Argus. Before pushing duo, confirm Argus and Revenant on the map.
891 hero damage per minute on a 644 norm, plus the enemy duo outer razed; 6 CS per minute trails a 7.7 norm. Between objectives, farm the nearest side lane.
9cd450ab-3271-4777-9c3f-d7b6c251e7cb: Ran the vision: 23 wards and 6 cleared, both the game's most, plus 45% kill participation. Before each Orb Prime, clear enemy wards around the pit approach first.
Three mid deaths after the duo lane opened, two outside any detected fight, two to Crunch. When Crunch is unseen late, hold Stasis Bomb for the Crunch dive.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: One death all game, 30322 hero damage, the allied high, and 12 CS per minute on a 10 norm. When Adele is dead, take the next offlane structure before rotating.
Argus and Revenant kills in the enemy half landed with the allied Primal Fangtooth, then razed the enemy duo inner. Once the offlane opens, join each Fangtooth.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Took 68146 damage, the most of all ten, and farmed 9.2 CS per minute on a 7.2 norm. Keep that clear pace whenever Crunch shows on another lane.
Crunch won the jungle trade two kills to one, the deaths landing just before the enemy Fangtooth and the lost allied offlane outer. Before contesting Fangtooth, confirm Crunch's location.

matchup: Legion was the lane opponent and never killed Lt. Belica; both Lt. Belica kills on Legion came in the enemy jungle.
Crunch's Forward Crunch dashes and stuns, and Turbo Crunch pushes heroes along: the main dive threat on the backline.
build: Noxia marks a hero on ability damage; a second ability on the marked hero adds bonus maximum-health damage.
Caustica ignores a share of magical armor and adds damage against healthy heroes with bonus magical armor.
Spellbreaker, finished last, blocks the next enemy ability with a spell shield; earlier fights ran without Spellbreaker.
eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration on casts and gold from spell damage on heroes; Bottomless Vial adds magical power per River Buff.
Vesh is the most played Lt. Belica mid Eternal, the only Eternal with enough games; Aion has too few games to rank.
Kit read: Runic Focus scales magical power with current mana, pairing with the mana regeneration from Aion.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience every second, scaling with hero level.
Combat Veteran and Devastating Bombs are a toss-up in the Lt. Belica mid field; Combat Veteran holds the best odds. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Epoch is the most played Lt. Belica mid crest, the only crest with enough games; Soulbearer has too few to rank.
improvement: No field-backed change: Vesh and Epoch lead only on games played, with no edge shown this patch.
Kit read: Epoch, also from Wizard Crest, trades the Soulbearer shield and lifesteal for a stasis against Crunch dives.

matchup: Crunch was the jungle opponent and the enemy's top killer: eight kills spread across all five allied heroes.
Crunch's 32164 hero damage led all ten players, and Crunch's 50171 mitigated damage was the game's most.
Crunch's Tainted Blade reduces the target's healing after physical damage, cutting into Draconum and Void Helm healing.
build: Sky Splitter basic attacks deal a share of the target's current health, suited to a frontline like Crunch.
Draconum adds physical armor, boosts healing while hitting heroes or monsters, and restores health on takedowns.
Void Helm, finished last, adds magical armor and boosts healing received; earlier fights ran without Void Helm.
eternal: Lotus randomly grants damage, haste, speed or health over time and on takedowns; Early Bloom adds an extra level.
Thraex is the most played Khaimera jungle Eternal, the only Eternal with enough games; Lotus has too few to rank.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion and Feral Ambush are a toss-up in the Khaimera jungle field; Jungle Invasion holds the best odds. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage around Khaimera and heals Khaimera on hero hits, later hits at half effectiveness.
Iceskorn Talons is the most played Khaimera jungle crest, the only crest with enough games; Judgement has too few to rank.
improvement: No field-backed change: Thraex and Iceskorn Talons lead only on games played this patch.
Kit read: Iceskorn Talons, also from Champion Crest, swaps the self-heal for an ice sheet that speeds and empowers allies.

matchup: Adele was the lane opponent: zero kills and five deaths, one to Greystone and three to Lt. Belica.
Crunch scored the only Greystone death, on the offlane in the allied half, then razed the allied offlane outer.
Adele's Imperial Lash and Queen's Garden root, and Royal Flourish mesmerizes.
build: Basilisk cuts physical armor on hero damage, stacking toward Eroded, on top of the Make Way armor shred.
Salvation grants a shield and omnivamp on dropping to low health, backing up the Stone Forged Soul heal.
Aegis Of Agawar, finished last, raises total armors, more at low health; earlier fights ran without Aegis Of Agawar.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero basic-attacked for more damage dealt and less taken; Savage Strikes adds healing on-hit damage.
Krix leans ahead of Thraex in the Greystone offlane field; Savage Strikes with Ferocity is the best Thraex pair.
augment: Close Cut makes Make Way deal more damage to the nearest enemy unit.
Close Cut and Tainted Oath are a toss-up in the Greystone offlane field; Close Cut holds the best odds. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active adds area damage beside Make Way and heals Greystone on hero hits, later hits at half effectiveness.
Judgement and Saphir's Mantle are a toss-up in the Greystone offlane crest field; Judgement holds the best odds. Sound keep.
improvement: Krix for Thraex is the field lean: more maximum health and size, giving up the duel mark and Savage Strikes healing.
Voracity with Cannibalism is the most played Krix pair; no Krix pair has enough games to be called best.

matchup: Duo was Sparrow and Dekker against Revenant and Argus; duo deaths before minute ten ran one allied to three enemy.
Argus and Revenant each killed Sparrow twice; Sparrow killed Revenant twice, once on the duo lane in the enemy half.
Revenant's Reckoning banishes a target into the Nether Realm with Revenant; Scar roots once all stacks are consumed.
build: Storm Breaker and Lightning Hawk both build Momentum while moving or attacking; the Lightning Hawk empowered hit also slows.
Scattershot summons homing projectiles from the target on hit, able to critically strike.
Imperator, finished last, raises critical strike damage; earlier fights ran without Imperator.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles on damaging a hero below a health threshold; Taproot heals on basic attacks.
Vermis and Weald are a toss-up in the Sparrow carry field; Vermis holds the best odds, with Weald tagged even.
Forage with Wind-Rider is the only Weald pair with enough games; Dryad's Boon with Taproot has too few.
augment: Sun Shards makes basic attacks ricochet, applying on-hit effects at reduced effectiveness.
Sun Shards, Inner Fury and Endless Hunt are a three-way toss-up in the Sparrow carry field; Sun Shards holds the best odds.
crest: Pacifier's active dashes and empowers the next physical hit, stronger on low-health targets, with a recast on hero kills.
Pacifier and Eviscerator are a toss-up in the Sparrow carry crest field; Pacifier holds the best odds. Sound keep.
improvement: Vermis for Weald, the toss-up lead: max-health damage every third consecutive basic attack on one hero, over low-health missiles.
If Weald stays, swap to Forage with Wind-Rider: extra farm gold, plus attack speed after a Pacifier dash.

matchup: Argus was the support opponent; Dekker killed Argus once, and both Argus kills landed on Sparrow.
Legion killed Dekker twice, once in the allied jungle right after the allied second Fangtooth.
Argus's Dread Nova stuns and Ether Crystal pushes and slows; Synaptic Obliterator leaves Argus immobile while firing.
build: Tainted Scepter reduces the target's healing after magical damage, trimming Re-Crunch healing.
Dreambinder slows enemies hit by ability damage, so Photon Disruptor hits carry the Dreambinder slow too.
Tainted Scepter, finished last, grows Malice stacks over time for extra ability damage; earlier fights ran without Tainted Scepter.
eternal: Vesh adds damage over time from ability damage on heroes; Mind Rot adds current-health damage to the major.
Vesh is the most played Dekker support Eternal, the only Eternal with enough games to lead.
Tithe of Death with Mind Rot, the pair run here, is the best Vesh pair in the field.
augment: Photon Efficiency makes Photon Disruptor hit harder and cuts the cooldown when hitting a hero.
Photon Efficiency is the most played Dekker support augment and the only augment with enough games; no edge is claimed.
crest: Leafsong's active speeds nearby allies and makes allies immune to slows; the passive raises the ward cap.
In a thin field, Leafsong leads a four-way toss-up with Rift Walkers, Silentium and Tranquility. Sound keep.
improvement: Kit read: an armor item over Dreambinder trades the ability slow for survival; Crunch and Legion scored four of five deaths.
No field-backed Eternal, augment or crest change: each pick is the most played or leads a toss-up.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.3s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
ourKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

teamComp.summary: Draft: 0 tanks, 2 divers vs their 1 tank, 1 diver. In 1.18 ranked, our shape won 48.2% and theirs 50.7%.

cc.note: They brought 11 hard-CC abilities to our 5. Fight after Argus's Dread Nova and Revenant's Scar and Adele's Royal Flourish are used, spread out instead of grouping in a line, and the front line can buy tenacity.

kit: Hard CC: Forward Crunch (stun + knockback), Right Crunch (knock-up + stun).
threat.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage
answers: Physical armor on whoever it kept killing.
Anti-heal: Tainted Rounds, or Tainted Charm or Tainted Totem.
Tenacity on the players it caught.
